comments: a35d6e9b: Initializes queue processing for Deferred IRT (Interdisciplinary Referral Tracking) options.
09eabd43: Set the scheduled time to the current $HOROLOG.
26f0a94e: Ensure ZTIO is defined even if ION is not or is empty, to prevent undefined errors.
7aa97e54: Set description for the queued task; default to 'IRT UNKNOWN OPTION' if not specified.
db18968e: Determine the routine to execute when the queued job runs; default to 'DQ^DGJUTQ' if routine not specified.
5aebcd11: Prepare variables to be saved (preserved) for the queued job.
f45716b1: Ensure the DGPGM variable is saved if it is set.
90cd8c4c: Load the task, show a message indicating whether the task was queued or cancelled, then exit or continue based on the result.
bd268caf: End of the queuing procedure.
9bc2f92b: Device handling; prompts for device input, allows task queuing, and ensures the device is not left open.
ac410a16: Use the selected device for output.
a0d3bc55: Iterate over the variables to be saved, adding each to the ZTSAVE array.
07e2a048: End of the SAVE subroutine.
55f00dfb: Converts '#' in DGZTSAVE to open parenthesis '(', preparing variables for structured storage.
85a7248c: End of the ARRAY subroutine.
3fa501a9: Closes device and task if not queued; runs device close logic.
ea8a0bbc: Clean up by killing all local variables used during the queuing process.
d72f5157: End of the cleanup routine.
3468ebe2: Execute the program specified in DGPGM or PGM variable, or close if neither is defined.
947574fb: Clears the task from the task global and closes the device.
261a0bd0: End of the DQ (DeQueue) subroutine.
587a47d3: Adjusts the task's scheduled execution time if a delay is specified in ZTSK("D").
3e99cf5c: End of the DTQ subroutine.
